owner: Qihan Zhu (user took over Controller, E and rerank changes on 2026-10-29)
goal: Improve final Test quality by recalibrating P60 coverage, choosing the action per Diagnosis label and the C1 prefill, all decided on Validation only.

split.ordering: allowed Validation IDs sorted by sha256([seed, 'validation', id]), the ordering that produced Development500 (first 500) and Selection500 (next 500)

roles.sweep: Reusable for the registered grid below; gold is read only offline for scoring.
roles.confirm: Run once on the single frozen configuration; never used to choose between configurations.
roles.test: Team Test 11,114 is run once at the end and reported as an exposed-Test re-evaluation; never used for any choice.

c1.reason: matches the frozen RAG baseline; removes the 2.6% chunked-prefill drift

precompute.failure_labeled: P3-20 retrieval_enhancement for every item, plus the label's own action when it differs
precompute.correct_labeled: P3-20 retrieval_enhancement when Diagnosis stage-1 p_fail >= 0.39 (about the top 20% of Development500 correct-labelled items under historical C1)
precompute.reproducibility_ids: first 200 sweep IDs, C1 to frozen selection run a second time

grid.recalibration: z-stats of p_fail, rec and p_corr from the sweep failure pool; t_insuff and t_combo set to the quantiles that give the target coverage and lane share

choice.metric: judge-assisted net (fixed minus broken) against C1 on the sweep set; UNCERTAIN is not correct; answers unchanged from C1 count zero
choice.tie_rule: configurations within 3 items of the best: take the lowest coverage, then the closed correct gate, then the action map earlier in the list
choice.fallback_metric: normalized-match net, reported alongside and used only if judge labels are unavailable
choice.confirm_success: judge-assisted net above 0 on the confirm set
